title: Finance Manager
description: Personal finance manager replacing two Excel spreadsheets: bank transactions with a verification queue, rule-based categorization, bucket-based investments, net worth, savings goal and debts. The transactions vertical already works end-to-end against the backend; the full 15-table schema is designed and applied.

title: TallerApp
descriptionHtml: End-to-end management for a multi-brand auto repair shop: clients and vehicles, repair orders, invoicing with PDF and email delivery, inventory with traceable stock and a KPI dashboard. Its core is the scheduler: a sequential queue per mechanic that respects the shop's real working hours and chains availabilities to compute each job's start and end. State machines for orders and invoices, audited critical flow and 259 unit tests. Final degree project (TFG).

title: Gym Tracker
description: Installable PWA for workout tracking: routines with supersets, weekly schedule, active session with autosave and a rest timer that survives the phone locking via Web Push. History, progress charts and a Coach that suggests cyclic double progression. Own login with passkeys (Face ID). In production since April 2026.

title: JASB Website
description: Corporate website for JASB Energy & Telco with custom i18n, Schema.org and SEO optimization. Accessible, multi-language and free of heavy dependencies.

title: POLYBOT · Algorithmic trading
descriptionHtml: Autonomous bot trading weather markets on Polymarket with real money: it pulls the Open-Meteo GFS ensemble (31 members), builds the empirical probability distribution, contrasts it against the order book and places on-chain orders sized by the Kelly criterion. 33 markets registered, 8 active. LLM decision agents, three layers of risk gates, on-chain fill reconciliation and a PWA dashboard with push notifications.
thumbAlt: Bot dashboard — global KPIs, P&L chart and market grid with individual stats
